q: In FastMCP, where does a tool’s input schema come from?
explain: Type hints become the JSON Schema; the docstring becomes the description.

q: Which testing step catches problems unit tests miss?
options: Watching a real agent use the server and reading the transcripts
explain: Agents reveal wrong-tool picks, bad arguments and oversized results.

q: Why keep tool definitions stable between releases?
options: Changes break hosts’ prompt caches and may trigger re-approval prompts
explain: Stable definitions help caching and trust.
